description: <= became <, so items exactly at the threshold are not reported.

mutation.old: return sorted(sku for sku in self._stock if self.available(sku) <= threshold)
mutation.new: return sorted(sku for sku in self._stock if self.available(sku) < threshold)

report_specific: low_stock(3) does not list an item that has exactly 3 units available. Items at the threshold should be included in the result.
report_vague: The low stock warning comes one item too late. Products that are about to run out are not flagged yet.
